seo_description: EdgeDesk prices Seattle Seahawks at Washington Commanders at Washington Commanders +5.3 with a 45.5 fair total. Seattle Seahawks wins 69% of simulations. Model status INVESTIGATE. Research, not picks.

research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 17 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. lede: Seattle Seahawks carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#10 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Washington Commanders +5.3 with a fair total of 45.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Seattle Seahawks pass offence vs Washington Commanders pass defence, which sits +0.214 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.

outcome_range.note: Quoted from the perspective of Washington Commanders, off the engine’s own learned margin distribution (conditioned on this spread, so real key-number mass is kept). Eight results in ten land inside p10–p90.

projection.confidence_absent_reason: The NFL model publishes no single confidence score. What it publishes instead is the width of the outcome range above and the sample the ratings rest on: the trained seeds through 2025, plus 17 absorbed 2026 games.
projection.status_note: EdgeDesk differs from the market by 2.8 points. That is enough to look harder — and out of sample no gap size of any width has cleared p<0.05 against the close, so it is a research prompt and not an edge.
projection.validation: UNPROVEN — this model does NOT beat the closing line out of sample. Research only; nothing here is graded as a bet.
